title: School and studying
intro: Watch two traps: la librería is a bookshop and the library is la biblioteca, and el colegio is a school, not a college. University is la universidad.

entries.warn: el colegio is not a college. Higher education is la universidad, and a university course is una carrera.

ex.es: Los niños salen del colegio a las dos.
ex.en: The children leave school at two.

entries.note: la facultad is the faculty or department you actually attend.

ex.en: She studies at the state university.

entries.note: el estudiante is used at any level and has one form for both sexes.

ex.es: Hay treinta alumnos en el grupo.
ex.en: There are thirty pupils in the class.

entries.note: toda clase de means all kinds of.

ex.es: La clase empieza a las nueve.
ex.en: The lesson starts at nine.
He sells all kinds of tools.

ex.es: Nos vemos en la clase de al lado.
ex.en: See you in the next classroom.

entries.note: la librería is a bookshop; la biblioteca the library. A classic false friend.

ex.es: Me presta el libro cuando lo termine.
ex.en: He'll lend me the book when he finishes it.
Write it down in your notebook.

entries.note: hacer el papel de is to play the part of.

ex.en: I need a sheet of paper.
He played an important role.

entries.note: Plural lápices. la pluma or el bolígrafo is a pen; la goma an eraser.

ex.es: Escribe con lápiz, por si te equivocas.
ex.en: Write in pencil, in case you make a mistake.

entries.note: hacer la tarea is to do your homework. los deberes in Spain.

ex.en: Have you done your homework?
It's a difficult task.

entries.note: Plural exámenes, which gains an accent. la prueba is a shorter test.

ex.en: I passed the exam by a whisker.

entries.note: suspender is used for failing in Spain. aprobar also means to approve.

ex.en: She passed with a good mark.
I failed chemistry last year.
I got a good mark in history.

ex.es: Me dejó una nota en la mesa.
ex.en: He left me a note on the table.

entries.note: hacer una pregunta is to ask a question — hacer, never preguntar una pregunta.

ex.en: May I ask a question?
I'm still waiting for his answer.

entries.note: Also a web page: la página web.

ex.es: Abran el libro en la página treinta.
ex.en: Open your books at page thirty.
I took a photography course.
The school year ends in June.

ex.es: Mi materia favorita es la historia.
ex.en: My favourite subject is history.
He's an expert on the subject.

entries.note: One word for both, which English keeps apart.

ex.en: She studied history in Mexico.
Tell me the whole story.

entries.note: Plural in Spanish. Shortened to mate or matemática in some countries.

ex.en: I was always bad at maths.
I practise Spanish every day.

ex.es: Practica natación dos veces por semana.
ex.en: He swims twice a week.
